name: Beim Dresch
beschreibung: Hotel Beim Dresch in Erl offers varied accommodation options across different categories to suit all needs. The establishment features an excellent on-site restaurant dedicated to authentic regional cuisine. Guest rooms are comfortably furnished with modern amenities. Located in a tranquil corner of Erl, the hotel is perfectly placed for discovering the rugged Kaisergebirge mountains and the picturesque Inn River. The traditional name Beim Dresch honors the locality's rural heritage, making the hotel an appealing destination for holidaymakers and business travelers alike.
